text:
alex: Heads-up: planning to deploy api-config + model-v2 to prod today 15:00 PT (23:00 UTC). Need a smoke owner and rollback lead. Target rollout: 20% canary for 10m then 100% if green. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-model-v2
priya: I can own smoke checks. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results.
jonah: I'll be rollback lead — do we have a feature flag for rollback? I don't want to hotfix code during ramp.
alex: No DB migration. Just model weights + config tweak. Feature flag lives under `model_v2_enabled` — we'll keep it off for 100% until promote step.
maya: I'll watch the latency/cost dashboards and prewarm caches. Ping me if token cost spikes.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex at 2026-03-18 15:00 PT. Canary plan: 20% for 10m. Notifying #eng-sre.
priya: Smoke checklist I'll run:
```
- sanity convo (sample prompt)
- p95 latency < 250ms
- 5xx < 0.5%
- embeddings checksum / shape
- token cost baseline
```
alex: tagging @sre-oncall — please set temporary alerts for GPU util > 80% and 5xx > 0.2%.
sre-oncall: on it. I'll add alerts and keep an eye on node autoscale.
jonah: PR #1234 merged. I'll add the rollback script to the deploy card. Rollback command is `./scripts/rollback_model.sh prod`.
priya: quick q — is canary routing by uid hash or region? need to pick test uids.
alex: by user-id hash (consistent). Use uid=1001 and uid=42 as test traffic.
priya: running staging smoke now, will post results in ~5m.
priya: staging smoke: pass. p95 210ms, errors 0.12%, token cost within 2%.
alex: starting canary rollout to 20% now. will wait 10m and check. Promote plan: if smoke green, flip `model_v2_enabled=true` for rest.
priya: canary 10m midpoint: metrics stable. continuing.
alex: promoting to 100% now. command I ran:
```
curl -XPOST https://console.internal/configs -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model_v2_enabled":true}'
```
jonah: rollback ready: `./scripts/rollback_model.sh prod` (run as ops user). I will be on-call for rollback for next 30m.
maya: flushing prefix cache for model_v2 and warming frequently-used keys.
priya: final smoke after promote: all green — latency p95 215ms, errors 0.15%.
alex: thanks all :tada: I'll update the deploy card and add notes. Closing this thread.
